notes.title: Early Access Release Changelog
notes.notes:
[h1]Lost In The Open[/h1][h2]Changelog[/h2][p][/p][p]We have implemented a great deal of changes since the last date we provided a changelog of in June. We are finally ready to enter Early Access. 

Below are all the changes we have implemented since then that we can remember and are not just run-of-the-mill bug fixes and so on. [/p][p]
[/p][h2]New Content[/h2][h3]Abilities & Combat Systems[/h3][p]* [b]New abilities added:[/b][/p][p]  * [b]Virulent Strike[/b] – new harmful attack.[/p][p]  * [b]Rending Strikes[/b] – added to Volkver and Grunt.[/p][p]  * [b]Quickstep Strike[/b] – added to Bounty Hunters.[/p][p]  * [b]Gushing Wound[/b] – added to Grunts.[/p][p]  * [b]Wounding Strike[/b] – added to Spearmen.[/p][p]  * [b]Smother Arrowhead[/b] – added to Bandit Archers.[/p][p]  * [b]Vulture Strike[/b] – new Bandit Pikeman ability.[/p][p]  * [b]Staunch Wound[/b] – added to Stratha Units and Polyomian Sentinel.[/p][p]  * [b]Mocking Taunt[/b] – new ability.[/p][p]  * [b]Bulwark[/b] – new shield ability, effectively a counterpart to [b]Raise Shield[/b].[/p][p]* **[b]Effect categories[/b]** (Neutral, Beneficial, Harmful) implemented.[/p][p]* **[b]Inherent Passives added:[/b]**[/p][p]  * Chop Through (Scouts).[/p][p]  * Swift Shooter (Archers).[/p][p]  * Partial Armor Damage (Maulman).[/p][p]  * Decapitation (Brute).[/p][p]  * Passives also added to Polyomian Macebearers, Enforcers, Bounty Hunters, and others.[/p][p][/p][h3]Leadership & Insights[/h3][p]* [b]New Leadership Tactics:[/b][/p][p]  * Multiple new options added, including improvements to flanking maneuvers and stamina refunds.[/p][p]  * Added [b]Focused Volley[/b], a leadership tactic focused on ranged units.[/p][p]  * Added [b]Rallying Strikes[/b], a leadership tactic focused on tight combat formations.  [/p][p]* [b]New Insights:[/b][/p][p]  * [b]Warmonger[/b], [b]Survival Training[/b], [b]Salvager[/b], [b]Precision Training[/b], [b]Side Dealings[/b], [b]Strike With Purpose[/b], [b]Shared Knowledge[/b], and more.[/p][p][/p][h3]Traits[/h3][p]* [b]New traits:[/b] Energetic, Strong-Willed, Weak-Willed.[/p][p][/p][h3]Units & Presets[/h3][p]* [b]Bandit Pikemen introduced:[/b][/p][p]  * New pike-based abilities.[/p][p]  * New inherent passive added.[/p][p]* [b]Additional units and updates:[/b][/p][p]  * Overhaul of Bandit Spearmen. He is no longer a 2-tile unit.[/p][p]  * Updated all enemy presets in the game, giving them new abilities, etc.[/p][p][/p][h3]Art, Icons & UI Assets[/h3][p]* Large batch of new [b]icons[/b]:[/p][p]  * Attachments, items, perks, enhancements, recruitment, stat enhancements (square/hex variants), ability icons (Pinpoint, Lethal Strike, etc.), precondition icons.[/p][p]* [b]New portraits[/b] added for Macebearer, Maulman, etc.[/p][p]* [b]New zone banners[/b] when entering a new zone.[/p][p]* [b]New UI elements:[/b][/p][p]  * Mortal Wound warning UI.[/p][p]  * Additional dimmers for unselected abilities/tactics in character panel.[/p][p]  * Improved icons for stat enhancements.[/p][p][/p][h3]Scenarios[/h3][p]* Big installation of new scenarios, including ‘transition’ specific encounters.[/p][p]* [b]Unique scenario rewards[/b] implemented across all transition scenarios.[/p][p]* [b]New final scenario[/b] implemented.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Gameplay & Balance[/h2][h3]General Balance[/h3][p]Balance, generally, should be greatly improved. We have tweaked so many things that it cannot be contained in this changelog. Below is a summary of what has changed.[/p][p][/p][p]* [b]Unit difficulty values[/b] adjusted:[/p][p]  * Ursadons made less punishing.[/p][p]  * Worfangs made more plentiful in combat.[/p][p]  * Difficulty values across all zones have been tweaked back and forth.[/p][p]  * Leader unit battles in general slightly nerfed.[/p][p]* [b]Unit stat scaling & recruitment:[/b][/p][p]  * Recruitment cost scaling increased across units.[/p][p]  * Recruitment cost in general significantly increased.[/p][p]  * Recruitment levels randomized more in zones 2–3 (including chance of lower-level units).[/p][p]  * Materials cost for upgrading equipment significantly increased.[/p][p]* [b]Experience & progression:[/b][/p][p]  * Adjusted XP gains:[/p][p]    * More XP awarded per kill. However, experience that is distributed to other units is massively reduced.[/p][p]    * Scenario XP reduced.[/p][p]    * Fixed issues where units leveled incorrectly in vendors or gained wrong skill points.[/p][p]* [b]Economy:[/b][/p][p]  * Increased scaling of unit costs based on level.[/p][p]  * Provisions cost for the King reduced from 3 to 1.[/p][p]  * Many leadership insights and various traits and so on now scale dynamically instead of yielding flat amounts.[/p][p]  * Attachment costs lowered overall.[/p][p][/p][h3]Abilities & Traits[/h3][p]* Dozens of [b]ability fixes, buffs, and nerfs[/b], including:[/p][p]  * [b]Buffs:[/b] Rapid Recovery, Blood Amulet, Heroic Strike (left path), Provoke, and more[/p][p]  * [b]Nerfs:[/b] Flanking Strike, Bogged Down, Coalition Power, Disciplined, Flanking Maneuvers Stamina Refund, many Ursadon abilities, and more[/p][p]  * [b]Reworks:[/b] Oiled Bolts now extend burning duration, Smother Arrowhead applies Stamina Reduction, Raise Shield adjusted to give Block Rating (not Protection Rating), and more[/p][p]  * [b]Fixed tooltips and mechanics[/b]: Victory Rush, Ironhide, Dazing Strike, Staunch Wounds, Crescendo Strike, Firebolt, Overhead Smash, Warmonger Insight, Defensive Order, Momentum Builder, Windup Strike, Energetic tooltip, and more.[/p][p][/p][h3]AI Improvements[/h3][p]* Ranged units will now back away from adjacent enemy units before shooting and reloading.[/p][p]* Two-tile units will back away from adjacent enemy units before attacking.[/p][p]* AI caching optimizations for performance.[/p][p]* Squashed a bug where certain enemy units had significantly higher starting attributes.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Audio & Visuals[/h2][h3]Sound & Music[/h3][p]* [b]Combat audio:[/b][/p][p]  * New SFX for death, injuries, blocking, buffs/debuffs, armor hits (per armor type), armor shatter, weapon swings (billhook, flail, 2h mace, hammer, etc.).[/p][p]  * Defeat and Victory music sounds with proper transitions.[/p][p]  * Added Death and Injury indicator SFXs.[/p][p]  * Updated effect sounds (Bleeding, Poison, Stun).[/p][p]  * Separate SFX for positive and negative buffs.[/p][p]* [b]Worldmap & ambience:[/b][/p][p]  * Animal sounds for Ursadon and others.[/p][p]  * New tough encounter music.[/p][p]  * New music for animals.[/p][p]  * New music for repentance path event.[/p][p]  * New UI sounds (hover, confirm, unavailable, back).[/p][p]  * Transition area sounds (Outskirts, Deepwoods, Outlands).[/p][p]* [b]Main menu:[/b][/p][p]  * New main menu music and background ambience.[/p][p]  * New sounds for UI interactions (New Game confirm, unavailable action, vendor interactions, skill upgrades).[/p][p][/p][h3]Visual Effects[/h3][p]* New [b]death VFX[/b].[/p][p]* New [b]injury VFX[/b].[/p][p]* [b]Blood splatter[/b] effect in combat. Togglable.[/p][p]* Shield blocking VFX, one for each shield type (e.g. Buckler, Shield).[/p][p]* Improved stamina bar responsiveness.[/p][p]* Improved visuals for when characters move during attacks/blows.[/p][p][/p][h3]Animations[/h3][p]* New idle animations for Macebearers, Ursadons, Worfangs, and more.[/p][p]* New animations for Bandit Pikemen.[/p][p][/p][h2]Worldmap & Scenarios[/h2][h3]Zones & Transition Areas[/h3][p]* Full implementation of [b]zones and transition areas[/b] (The Outskirts, Deepwoods, Outlands).[/p][p]* Transition areas now include:[/p][p]  * A buffer against Stratha encroachment, giving the player a “break” between different zones from being pursued.[/p][p]  * Unique transition scenarios with unique rewards and enemy units.[/p][p]  * Unique pre-/post-transition scenarios, with unique events.[/p][p][/p][h3]Biomes & Visuals[/h3][p]* Added [b]new hextile types[/b]: impassable and slow-passable variants.[/p][p]* Improved encounter maps visually for the biome Withering Grove.[/p][p]* Clouds and birds added with animations.[/p][p]* Lakes and rivers updated with better ambience.[/p][p]* Updated fogging.[/p][p]* Significant improvement of visuals of all hex tiles in the game[/p][p][/p][h3]Pathing & Map Generation[/h3][p]* Improved [b]Dead-end detection and repair[/b] implemented.[/p][p]* Improved pruning of overlapping paths.[/p][p]* Fixed issues with saving/loading transition nodes.[/p][p] [/p][h2]UI & UX[/h2][p]* [b]Main Menu:[/b][/p][p]  * New animated main menu.[/p][p]  * Logo localized to Simplified Chinese.[/p][p]  * Discord link and Simplified Chinese localized social media button added.[/p][p]  * Improved Difficulty Selection visuals.[/p][p]  * Improved Settings menu visuals.[/p][p]* [b]Combat UI:[/b][/p][p]  * Turn tracker highlights unit portraits when hovered, and allows inspection via RMB.[/p][p]  * ESC key closes current open panels before pause.[/p][p]  * Improved hotbar/stamina previews (show stamina loss on hover, availability after movement, reset on hover over UI).[/p][p]  * Improved UX for the turning arrow helping you decide the direction of your character when moving in combat[/p][p]  * Updated visuals for all tooltips in the game.[/p][p]  * Tooltip UX improved with clearer positive/negative/warning color titles.[/p][p]  * “Blocked!” text added when fully blocking an attack.[/p][p]  * Killed and Injured units during combat will persist in the army panel, showing what has happened to them.[/p][p]  * Stamina gains during combat show as combat text.[/p][p]  * Improved combat camera movement.[/p][p]  * Overall improved UX experience in combat.[/p][p]* [b]Character Panel:[/b][/p][p]  * Improved character panel visuals with better visual emphasis on what is important.[/p][p]  * Added injury overlay in character panel to make treating injuries significantly clearer.[/p][p]  * New sound for opening/closing character panel.[/p][p]* [b]Vendors/Recruitment:[/b][/p][p]  * Resource panel colors corrected (gold coins red when insufficient).[/p][p]  * Icons and tooltips improved.[/p][p]  * New sound for opening/closing vendors.[/p][p]* [b]Other Improvements:[/b][/p][p]  * Loading screen added for scene transitions.[/p][p][/p][h2]Localization[/h2][p]* [b]Major[/b] [b]localization overhaul[/b]:[/p][p]  * Hundreds of fixes across abilities, leadership, insights, scenarios, tooltips, and UI.[/p][p]  * Rewrites of: ability chains, genproperties, perks, abilities, tutorials, notifications, scenario texts.[/p][p]  * Consistency improvements (British English spellings, Z→S fixes).[/p][p]  * Full update of Chinese localization + added logo + social media button.[/p][p]  * Better save/load handling of locale in menus.[/p][p][/p][h2]Performance & Stability[/h2][p]* [b]Performance Optimizations:[/b][/p][p]  * Significant caching improvements in UI and AI scripts across both overworld and combat scenes.[/p][p]* [b]Stability Fixes:[/b][/p][p]  * Fixed numerous save/load issues (scenarios, nodes, trader availability, transition states).[/p][p]  * Fixed various bugs, e.g. targeting bugs, stamina effects not applying, tooltip inconsistencies.[/p][p]  * And tons more stability fixes.[/p][p][/p][h2]Demo & Build Support[/h2][p]* [b]Demo build system implemented:[/b][/p][p]  * Restricts playthrough to a limited part of the game.[/p][p]  * Demo win screen and proper end screens for win/loss/demo.[/p][p][/p][h1]Summary[/h1][p]Since late June, Lost In The Open has seen a huge expansion of content (abilities, traits, units, scenarios, art, icons, music), heavy gameplay balancing, major localization cleanup, UI/UX polish, audio-visual upgrades, and significant performance/stability improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]The game is now richer, smoother, more balanced, and more stable. It is ready for Early Access.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the game on Friday! We will happily read your reviews and feedback. [/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to join our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FmkcmKw8ZC4"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Kindly,[/p][p]Black Voyage Games[/p]

notes.title: Release in 4 days
notes.notes: [p]Hello all[/p][p][/p][p]We've been crazy busy preparing for release recently and haven't made any updates in news.[/p][p][/p][p]We have addressed what players found to be the most important issues in the game. For example, the injury system which was unintuitive has had a major UI improvement. Localization has been greatly improved. Difficulty tweaked to be more even across the playthrough, and clearer. Etc.[/p][p][/p][p]We will make a huge post about all the changes made to the game. Should come soon, right before or on release.[/p][p][/p][p]We are very excited about launch, hoping everything goes well. Thank you to those who have been playing the game and giving feedback, it has been invaluable.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading,[/p][p]Black Voyage Games[/p]

notes.title: Lost in the Open - Big Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We're coming to you today with a message and an update.

Whether this is your first time in the "Open" or arriving from the [b]MGN Carnival[/b], a warm welcome! We're glad to have you with us as you try our turn-based, strategy-driven dark roguelike, [i]Lost in the Open[/i].

To give [i]Lost in the Open[/i] the showcase it deserves, we’ve decided to update the available demo. This new build includes a number of refinements and changes we've been working on for several months now, all of them designed to better reflect the direction and tone we're looking to achieve moving forward.

[b]Here’s what’s new in the demo:[/b]
– A reworked [b]Leadership System[/b] with [i]Insights[/i] and [i]Tactics[/i] that shape your party's growth and combat potential
– [b]King Progression[/b]: Your ruler now evolves—and if he falls, it’s game over
– A revamped [b]Injury System[/b] with lasting effects and high-stakes consequences
– Complete [b]Equipment and Vendor Overhaul[/b]
– [b]Save/Load support[/b] and a [b]cleaner UI[/b]
– Now available in [b]Simplified Chinese[/b]

Whether you find it enjoyable or unnervingly suspenseful, we invite you to follow King Nrvesk as he flees through the deadly lands of Ruedome, fighting not only for the continuation of his legacy but for survival.

* Black Voyage Games

notes.title: Lost In The Open Enters Turn-Based Carnival
notes.notes:
Exciting News for Lost In The Open!

Lost In The Open has officially entered the Turn-Based Carnival event on Steam! To check out the gritty, survival-driven gameplay and tough, tactical decision-making, you can play the demo which will be updated with the latest content for the festival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/140caa78fb0be6caa4ed96a4747713140f467d5d.jpg[/img]

We might have some exciting, important news to share with you soon. Early Access is getting more and more relevant for us.

The festival starts 13th of November. Head over there, check out other great games as well, and let us know what you think. This event is a chance for us to connect with people interested in the game, so don’t miss out on Turn-Based Carnival.

Salute, folks. :)

notes.title: ***Patch 0.5.5***
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We hope you had a refreshing summer! Apologies for the long break from posting; development in summer slowed down a bit as everyone on the team enjoyed some well-deserved breaks and vacations. But don’t worry—we’ve jumped back into action and have some exciting updates to share with you.

[b]MAJOR UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*] New Worfang enemy: This enemy now spawns in dense and normal forest. Worfangs attack in packs, ambush players, and can tear units apart! Beware of their pinning ability, which can disable one of your units and requires assistance to break free.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/11d202a2dc17b0fe44d3a74bbe3f0e955c0213af.gif[/img]
[*] Environmental tiles: We’ve added environmental tiles that cause negative effects if you stand on them. The game now features Rusty Traps, Muddy Ground, and Overgrown Roots, appearing in various biomes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/65c8b52b4c58f9261560668078768aaee1d7337f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/5197bf2189577dfeb466c289d38eefe98da35858.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/e2314b055ac0e5964f04f82da0f0176a80b41cf9.jpg[/img]
[*] New Barricade sprites for blockade encounters: Barricades now visually differentiate battles where enemies have set up defenses opposed to regular camps, adding more variety to encounters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/93ffc298f54b8ce11f18fc5d6f5206066c7462a2.jpg[/img]
[*] Probabilistic tiles: Some tiles now randomize what spawns on them. For example, a tile might spawn a tree, or it might spawn nothing. Alternatively, a tile could spawn Muddy Ground, a crate, or other elements. This introduces randomness to combat maps that wasn’t present before.
[*] Improved Tree Art: We’ve enhanced the art for all trees in the game, providing a more immersive visual experience. (Check environmental tiles images for refference)
[/list]
[b]MINOR UPDATES[/b]

Adjustments:
[list]
[*] Improved "Rage" tooltip
[*] Updated tooltip descriptions for all stats
[*] The "Skeleton Key" no longer drops from encounters
[*] Renamed "Strange Figurine" to "Blind Frenzy" with the same functionality as before
[*] Renamed "Daunting Strike" node upgrade to "Misdirected Frenzy," prioritizing hitting allies
[*] Renamed "Blind Rage" perk to "Focused Frenzy," prioritizing hitting enemies
[*] Abilities that cause displacement (e.g., pushback or disengage) will now function even if the target tile is unwalkable
[*] "Whirlwind" can no longer be used by the AI if they only have allies nearby
[*] Consolidated "Open Wound" tooltip for both 1-tile and 2-tile versions
[*] Improved "Final Flourish" tooltip to better reflect its effects
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the "Peak Condition" buff, which was being removed too early in the previous version
[*] Fixed a bug where ending a turn too early (while still walking) caused errors in the game
[*] Fixed "Prey on the Weak," which wasn’t functioning correctly in the previous version
[*] Fixed "Reload" to no longer display a cooldown
[/list]
Balance Adjustments:
[list]
[*] Buffed "Precise Strike" for two-handed melee units
[*] Buffed "Designate Target"
[*] Buffed "Mark Target" to always hit the target
[*] Buffed several equippable items
[*] Buffed "Finishing Blow" and added new upgrade nodes
[*] Buffed Brute’s final equipment by 1 armor rating
[*] Lowered upgrade costs on the left side of the "Wild Strikes" chain
[*] Nerfed the overall difficulty of Stratha units, resulting in fewer units spawning compared to before
[*] Nerfed "Open Wound"
[*] Added an extra upgrade node for "Adrenaline"
[*] "Thousand Strikes" was nerfed and reintroduced
[*] Enforced a minimum of 1 damage on Damage Over Time effects (they can no longer deal 0 damage)
[*] All Standard Enhancements—"Aggressiveness," "Survivability," and "Versatility"—now have 3 possible tiers that can randomly appear during level up. Higher ranks of these enhancements progressively become stronger.
[/list]

SNEAK PEEK
If you’ve made it through all the changes, congratulations! We have something too cool not to share with you. We proudly present the mighty Ursadon! More info to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/7254cdb94be29aa4c8ca95c289f9f5f1d30e7a36.gif[/img]

notes.title: **Patch 0.5.1**
notes.notes:
Dear players,

First of all, we want to thank you for participating in the "Steam Next Fest" and playing our demo. We really appreciate you checking out our game and providing feedback. With the addition of a lot of content in patch 0.5.0, a smaller patch was needed to adjust the balance and fix any bugs that slipped through. Again, we must thank the passionate players who joined our public Discord and shared their experiences with the game.

[b]Added:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fail Safe: We are still dealing with some game-freezing bugs during encounters that are not easily replicated and fixed. We’ve added code that should detect such scenarios and return you to the world map, resulting in a win. This is primarily to prevent players from losing their runs, but we will continue working on removing these bugs entirely.
[*] "Cleave" Perk
[*] "Thousands Strikes" Ability
[/list]

[b]Removed:[/b]

[list]
[*] Many old sprites to reduce game size (about 15% reduction in disc size)
[*] "Swift Strike" - Temporarily removed to rework it in the future. In its current state, you need to build the entire character around this ability for it to work properly.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed duel combat
[*] Fixed "Lone Wolf" using stamina
[*] Fixed "Riposte" not hitting three times
[*] Fixed "Gushing Wound" tooltip
[*] Fixed issue with Flanking tutorial notification
[*] Fixed "Shieldbreaker" tooltip damage
[/list]

[b]Balance Adjustments:[/b]

[list]
[*] Swift Shooter can now give a maximum of 10 stamina
[*] Rapid fire dropped cost reduction by 1
[*] Training Manual XP gain will now be based on Nrvesk level
[*] Nerfed some fighting pit presets
[*] Nerfed ranged equipment damage
[*] Nerfed overall Dodge rating of "Evasion"
[*] Nerfed "Open Wound"
[*] Buffed "Bounty Hunter" health
[*] Adjusted "Final Flourish" - Reduced the needed stacks to activate and slightly nerfed its damage
[*] Buffed "Critical Mastery" stat gain
[/list]


Apart from this smaller update, we also spent the last two weeks discussing the direction of the game and brainstorming ideas. We have some great concepts that we hope to implement in the best and most fun way possible in the future. We will keep you updated.

All the best,
The Black Voyage Games Team

notes.title: Escape your doom in Lost In The Open - Live dev playthrough
notes.notes:
[b]Watch our Stream![/b]

We are hosting a fun hour-long developer stream as part of the Steam Next Fest. Get ready to dive into strategic gameplay, challenging battles, and the unpredictable twists that make every run a unique experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/6dd23c952919c9a8f3893e54aaf3cae81d995e69.png[/img]

We will guide you through "Lost In The Open." We’ll start from the beginning and strive to reach the end, showcasing the depth and replayability that defines this title.

We’ll discuss the design philosophy behind the game, share tips and strategies, and our vision for the future of the game. This is a fun opportunity to interact with the developers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/85246ff956baf3b14a452c12578507a003090790.png[/img]

Join us and let's play. Tune in to the "Lost In The Open - Steam Next Fest Developer Stream" and become part of our journey. Win or lose, it’s going to be a fun time. See you there!

notes.title: **Patch 0.5.0**
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We have some exciting news about the newest patch, 0.5.0. This update introduces a lot of new content to the game. Let's go through the list together.

[b]Major Changes:[/b]

[b]Devastating Wound[/b] - A new narrative feature gives the King a devastating wound after an unsuccessful assassination attempt at the start of the game. This makes the King significantly weaker, lowering his health and stamina. However, we have compensated for this by buffing the bodyguards. The debuff can be removed with some help after traveling for some time. This feature is currently a work in progress, but in the future, we plan to enable a "hard mode" through this event, allowing players to refuse this help.

[b]New Unit: Stratha Arbalest[/b] - Now you can acquire Stratha Arbalest deserters. This unit has a shorter range than the regular archer, but can deal a lot of damage in quick succession. It also has the Fire Shot ability, which is unique to the Arbalest unit.

[b]New Unit: Stratha Swordsman[/b] - Another recruitable Stratha deserter unit. This one can become a serious damage dealer. With access to many melee abilities and great basic attack upgrades, this unit can become very impactful on the battlefield when upgraded.

[b]New Unit: Enforcer[/b] - A true tank unit armed with a mace and shield. This unit has the highest basic armor and armor efficiency in the game. Despite its low damage output, this unit shines with defensive options and crowd control abilities.

[b]New Unit: Bounty Hunter[/b] - A squishy, high damage dealer with the highest base movement speed in the game. This unit dual-wields a rapier and a dagger, either of which can be upgraded for a unique playstyle. Will you opt for a duelist setup or a flanking assassin?

[b]New Recruit Events[/b] - With new units, we had to adjust the current recruit events. Many previous events were adjusted to include chances of acquiring some of the new units, and we've added unique events that guarantee some of the new ones.

[b]Adjusted Accuracy[/b] - We have adjusted accuracy in the game as it was slightly higher than we wanted it to be, making future accuracy stacking much valuable. To compensate, we also distributed accuracy stats across all weapon upgrades.

[b]Equipment Upgrade Cost[/b] - With the accuracy adjustment and its impact on the game, we have decreased the equipment upgrade cost to incentivize upgrading equipment.

[b]Bodyguards' Starting Abilities[/b] - Bodyguard Volkver now starts with the "Open Wounds" ability and Marske starts with "Shield Bash." This change provides players with better starting playstyle options, whether they prefer the original tank-bodyguard playstyle or a more balanced damage dealer approach.

[b]Passive Healing Change[/b] - Passive healing while traveling has been adjusted from a flat value to 12%/8%/5% based on the selected difficulty.

[b]New Upgrade Options[/b] - We've added many upgrade options to slightly underwhelming abilities through the skill point system to make them more viable.

[b]Two Traits for Units[/b] - Units now have a chance to receive two traits instead of one.

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]

[b]Buffed Abilities:[/b]
•	Ebb and Flow
•	Wild Strikes
•	Aimed Shot
•	Hamstring Shot
•	Knockback Strike
•	Piercing Strike
•	Unbalancing Strike (this one is particularly challenging to balance o_O)
•	Isolated
•	Bully
•	Solidarity

[b]Nerfed Abilities:[/b]

•	Open Wounds

Apart from these balancing changes, we have also identified and corrected a huge list of bugs, too extensive to be listed here. With so much new content, some bugs may have slipped through the cracks, so we encourage you to report any issues on our public Discord or leave a comment on our community page.
That’s all for today’s patch notes. We hope you enjoy the recent changes as much as we did.

All the best from,
The Black Voyage Games Team

notes.title: **Patch 0.4.5**
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We're excited to bring you Patch 0.4.5, featuring many exciting changes to Lost In The Open.

**Armor Rework** - Instead of simply reducing physical damage, armor now grants extra "buffer" health. This buffer takes reduced damage, and once it breaks, the character becomes vulnerable and takes full damage from all physical attacks.

**Scaling Recruits** - Previously, recruits started at level 1, often resulting in them being killed in their next fight without a chance to level up. Now, recruits will reach level 2 at 40% completion of the map and level 3 at 80% completion.

**Random Recruit Abilities** - New recruits now gain a random second ability instead of a fixed one. This change allows players to experiment with different abilities and explore their upgrade paths.

In addition to these significant quality-of-life improvements, we've made numerous UI enhancements and tooltip corrections for clearer understanding of game mechanics. We've also focused on balancing updates, particularly on XP gain and buffing some underwhelming abilities.

**Bug Fixes:**
- Fixed the "Achilles Heel" effect
- Corrected buffs/debuffs staying one turn longer than intended
- Fixed the "Second Wind" perk
- Corrected the duration of "Rally"
- Fixed "Critical Surge" not proccing
- Fixed "Mobility" not proccing
- Resolved issue where upgraded "Daze" allowed "Paralyze" effect to be procced with any other "Daze" effect
- Fixed "Adrenaline" to give the correct amount of stamina
- Fixed being able to afford "Cutting Gems" without having enough money
- Fixed the duel event freezing the game, preventing further progress
- Fixed "Daze" on the basic attack upgrade of Bodyguard to have the correct duration
- Fixed duplicated descriptions on abilities
- Fixed game freeze during the merchant event
- Fixed game freezing at the start, forcing players to restart

notes.title: LITO Joins Endless Replayability Festival
notes.notes:
Hello Steamers!

Endless Replayability Fest starts in a few hours! We previously entered Turn-Based Thursday Festival which was a great success for us. We are hoping for the same on Endless Replayability Fest.

Our game is a classic roguelike combined with tactical RPG. Procedural generation, random progression, and so on. That's the gist of it. So it fits very well with "Endless Replayability".

On May 2nd we entered G.Round, a playtesting community that has given us invaluable feedback to prepare for today's festival. The demo we have now is polished to a degree that would be hard to do without 100 playtesting reviews that point out every single bug under the sun in Lost In The Open. :)

The current iteration, while still a playable demo, somewhere between alpha and beta, is the most polished LITO has ever been.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/a3811c340d0c8c8bb3886f0574ce1f9c77bad804.png[/img]
[i]Fighting the new Stratha faction[/i]

Check out our game during the Fest! The demo will be available all throughout. We are very excited to see what people think and to get some eyeballs on the game.

Cheers!

notes.title: Escape assassination as new fantasy roguelike gets a free Steam demo
notes.notes:
Take those beautiful fantasy landscapes of the best RPGs like Baldur's Gate 3 and Skyrim, and infuse it with a tense, resource-scarce fight for survival blending tough decision-making and grid-based tactical combat. What you have is new roguelike strategy game Lost In the Open, which sees you attempting to stay alive against all odds in a challenging series of encounters as you try and keep one step ahead of your pursuers. If you think you're up to the task, a new free demo out now on Steam is the perfect chance to test your mettle.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Lost In The Open Meets G.Round
notes.notes:
Hello again!

We will be entering G.Round on May 2nd! We entered G.Round back in January with a janky demo, and have now improved it massively. We are very excited to see what players think now.

G.Round will be important to make sure the demo is as polished and bug-free as it can be for Endless Replayability Fest (13th of May) and Steam Next Fest (10th of June) coming up.

The latest significant addition to the game is the [i]Tutorial[/i]. Rather than throw a wall of text at the player as soon as they enter the game, we now have a [i]notification system[/i] which gives little hints and explanations when the player actually needs it. For example, [i]Flanking[/i], which is a huge mechanic in the combat, is explained after someone has been flanked, pausing the game and showing an explanatory gif and some text.

This should make the game a lot easier to understand for new players. 

As developers, it can be hard for us to see the game with fresh eyes since we work on it every day. So we anticipate that the tutorial will need to be modified a great deal to [i]properly[/i] be helpful to new players. Which is why G.Round will be very good for us. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/7fc0fe535e6727a00a24d7a3e7786135ff182032.png[/img]
[i]Tutorial notification explaining flanking[/i]

May is going to be intense. Endless Replayability Fest starts in a little more than two weeks! The festival starts on the 13th of May and lasts until May 20 and showcases roguelike and procedural games. We are attending. :)

You will be able to play the latest demo in that festival!

Cheers ːsteamthisː

notes.title: Super happy to have participated in Turn-Based Thursday Festival
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

From the 4th of April to the 8th, we participated in Turn-Based Thursday Festival, a super fun and successful event!

We were one small indie game in a sea of big titles such as Darkest Dungeon 2 and we are honored to have had the opportunity.

We came into the event with huge changes to the game. For those who have followed the Steam page, we have changed almost all gifs/screenshots to the new artstyle and combat system. The game has matured significantly, and that has showed in the wishlist count of the game, which we increased by about 50% by the end of the festival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/0d1e89bb23c9cc09e4310c141ca10c5e64b7b56e.png[/img]
[i]New artstyle and combat system featuring whirlwind[/i]

Next up is Endless Replayability Fest! Starting on May 13, it lasts until May 20 and will feature games with procedural generation and roguelike elements. We are a perfect match for it. ːsteamhappyː

We want to prepare well for this event. After going through a lot of player feedback, we've realized it's finally time to put focus on [i]tutorial[/i] and [i]polish[/i]. We want to show what Lost In The Open really has to offer. That has been hindered by player's not being given enough guidance and clarity during gameplay. We want to iron out the edges and add dynamic tutorials (think Baldur's Gate 3!) to make it less confusing and more fun to play the game.

After that, it's time for Steam Next Fest on June 10... but more on that another time :)

Cheers ːsteamthisː

notes.title: Kickstarter Update and The Plan Forward!
notes.notes:
🚀 Hey there! Kickstarter Update and The Plan Forward! 🚀

First off, we want to give a massive shoutout to all of you amazing folks who were with us from the start of our Kickstarter campaign. Unfortunately, as many of you know, the Kickstarter was canceled due to a lack of momentum.

Now, don't worry, we're not throwing in the towel! The Kickstarter provided invaluable insight into issues with the game and has made us truly appreciate the importance of getting feedback directly from players. As a consequence, we're more grounded than ever to make this game a reality, and we've got a solid plan moving forward.

🎮 Searching for a Publisher

We're on the hunt for a publisher who's as stoked about our game as we are. Testing the waters, the response we've gotten so far has been promising. Teaming up with a publisher will give us the resources and expertise we need to take this game to the next level. We're committed to delivering something that'll blow your socks off, and a publisher will help us do just that.

🌄 Heavily Revamped Exploration

We've been grinding away to make the exploration part of the game far, far more compelling. It is now much more strategic and clear. The world you're gonna dive into is now more dangerous, more dynamic while also much more understandable to casuals and hardcore alike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/00d9ac9e8235b6d6e419a4a1a4d840a3200b37b3.gif[/img]

🖼️ Fresh Steam Page Updates

Our Steam page just got a major facelift. We've loaded it up with tons of new screenshots and gifs that showcase the revamped exploration and improved combat. We hope you can see much clearer what we are going for with this game. It's all about making this game as compelling as it can be, and conveying that!

💬 Hang Out on Discord and Follow Us on Twitter

We want to keep the conversation going with all of you. It is incredibly important for the future of LITO. If you are interested, please consider joining our Discord channel for real-time chats, updates, and to be a part of the development journey. And give us a follow on Twitter @blackvoyagegame if that's your platform. Your feedback and enthusiasm mean the world to us.

Thank you for sticking with us. We would have loved for the Kickstarter to have succeeded, but it's not an easy thing to do. We're all about making this game the best it can be. Together, we can create something refreshing and deep.

Thanks for being part of the LITO community. Stay tuned for more updates!

With heaps of gratitude and excitement,

Black Voyage Games

notes.title: Kickstarter is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello fellow bandits,[/h2]

Here's a quick update -- Call it community update 1.5.
Last week we introduced ourselves to you and our vision for Lost in the Open. We’re excited to share that our Kickstarter campaign is live NOW. This also means that you can be among the first to play Lost in the Open with our first-ever demo available from the Kickstarter campaign page. The Kickstarter trailer can be watched below.

[previewyoutube=myLKNnSjB4I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]So, Why Kickstarter?[/h3]

We are hugely passionate about Lost In The Open and have been working on it for a little more than three years, with the last six months being full-time and self-funded. During this time, the project made big leaps. However, for us to continue in a full-time capacity and hit our [b]June 2024 release date[/b], we need your support! All of the funding will go towards development costs, including payments to our composer, sound designer, and additional programmers to assist with the game mechanics workload.

Exceeding our funding goal will allow us to pursue stretch goals we have had to postpone to focus on completing the core features. We're thrilled about the game's potential and eagerly await your support to realize our vision.

Most importantly, the Kickstarter community will provide us with invaluable feedback on all aspects, especially the combat gameplay. The game mechanics require precision, and we count on the community's input to fine-tune the combat experience. [b]Your interest and support mean the world to us, and we sincerely hope you'll share the project with your friends too! Thank you![/b]

notes.title: Community Update 1: Kickstarter Launch Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello fellow bandits,[/h2]

Welcome to our first community update!

Over the past two years, we’ve been working hard on Lost in the Open, a challenging turn-based strategy game inspired by the likes of Battle Brothers, Darkest Dungeon, and many others. We plan to release the game in 2024, but before we hit that milestone, we have some exciting news to share:

[h3]Our Kickstarter campaign is going live on July 19, 2023![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/67850cf72fa4d83a23089789eda35b6e5a48ee5f.png[/img]

Lost in the Open is getting a [b]limited-time demo[/b] to accompany the launch of its Kickstarter campaign on the 19th of July, 2023. Over the past 6 weeks, we have been working tirelessly to get the demo ready and showcase a great example of what we want to achieve with the full release of Lost in the Open. You can watch the trailer for it below.

[previewyoutube=myLKNnSjB4I;full][/previewyoutube]

Lost in the Open delivers its gameplay in a roguelike fashion, where death means starting all over again. This demo offers a full, but condensed gameplay loop, which is a shortened version of the game’s opening act. The demo includes:

[list]
[*] Multiple different combat scenarios
[*] Recruiting new bandits to join your team
[*] Leveling system to unlock new abilities
[*] Items to find from combat or buy/sell from the trader
[*] Flanking and positioning mechanics to reward tactical combat gameplay
[*] A final encounter that’s quite a challenge. Only a few of us have beaten it so far!
[/list]
Your support since we launched the Steam page has been amazing. We would love your help with the launch of our Kickstarter campaign, not just through backing, but the sharing of the campaign. Our vision is to make Lost in the Open a fun, challenging, and memorable turn-based title, and a successful Kickstarter campaign will allow us to do that.

Once again, thank you for your support,
